newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaireans attack Hutu refugee camps - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Zaireans attack Hutu refugee camps - witnesses.

text.p: Zairean villagers armed with machetes attacked Rwandan refugee camps in eastern Zaire on Tuesday to avenge the killing of six Zaireans, eyewitnesses said.
They said residents of Kasese village 25 km (15 miles) south of Kisangani city left at dawn for two nearby camps for 55,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees to take revenge and shooting followed.
"This morning at 6 a.m. the villagers decided to go and take revenge and make the refugees flee. They took machetes," said Samy Janga, a Kasese schoolteacher.
"Soon afterwards we heard shooting which went on for an hour and a half. Some villagers ran into the forest to hide," said Janga, who said he was also fleeing the fighting.
Zaireans returning towards Kisangani from villages near Kasese said fighting on Tuesday made it impossible to pass on the main road.
Six Zaireans were killed and two wounded at Kasese on Monday in an attack blamed by villagers on Hutu militants.
